jobs.title: Process Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Established in 2021, **Independence Pet Holdings** is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi-brand and omni-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

**Pets Best**, a subsidiary of IPH, offers pet insurance and wellness plans for dogs and cats in every state. Founded in 2005 with a mission to provide access to comprehensive animal healthcare at an affordable price, Pets Best delivers flexible coverage, an easy claims process, and excellent customer service.

**Pets Best** is seeking a **Process Implementation Manager**.

**Job Summary:**

The **Process Implementation Manager** serves as a key coordination partner for Regulatory Enablement, Forms Implementation, Carrier Operations, and cross-functional business change initiatives across Pets Best. Working closely with Intake Management, Compliance, Legal, Product, Technology, PMO, Operations, and Carrier stakeholders, this role helps ensure regulatory, carrier, and operational requirements are effectively coordinated, communicated, tracked, and implemented across the organization. This individual will help establish operational rhythm, strengthen implementation governance, promote operational readiness, and drive successful execution of approved initiatives. This position provides dedicated ownership of Regulatory Enablement support, Forms Implementation coordination, Carrier Operations support, operational readiness, stakeholder engagement, and business change enablement activities. The role serves as a critical partner in strengthening implementation governance, execution consistency, and cross-functional Pets Best to Doubtless coordination.

**Job Location:** Remote – USA, Candidates in CST or EST time zones strongly preferred.

**Main** **Responsibilities:**

**Regulatory Enablement & Implementation**

* Coordinate regulatory, carrier-driven, and business change initiatives.
* Support review, documentation, communication, and implementation of regulatory and carrier requirements.
* Translate business requirements into actionable implementation plans.
* Maintain implementation documentation, requirements, and stakeholder communications.
* Monitor implementation progress and escalate risks, barriers, and dependencies.

**Forms Implementation & Operational Readiness**

* Coordinate carrier forms implementation activities across the organization.
* Facilitate requirements gathering, business impact assessments, implementation planning, and readiness activities.
* Lead cross-functional discovery sessions and implementation-related meetings.

* Track milestones, deliverables, action items, and implementation commitments.
* Support post-implementation validation and issue resolution activities.

**Cross-Functional Coordination & Governance**

* Coordinate regulatory inquiries, legal inquiries, carrier implementation requests, and related business initiatives.
* Partner with Product, Compliance, Legal, Technology, PMO, Customer Care, Claims, and Carrier stakeholders.
* Prepare implementation status reporting, dashboards, and stakeholder updates.
* Support audit requests, remediation activities, MCAS/MCE coordination, and governance reporting.

**Basic** **Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* 5+ years of experience in insurance operations, regulatory enablement, compliance support, forms implementation, business analysis, project coordination, or related functions.
* Experience supporting cross-functional business initiatives and implementation efforts.
* Strong organizational, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple initiatives while maintaining attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Teams, SharePoint, and related business tools.

* Strong execution and follow-through.
* Ability to establish operational rhythm, create structure, and drive accountability in evolving environments.
* Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities and stakeholder expectations.
* Experience building, documenting, and improving business processes.
* Skilled at coordinating across multiple stakeholders and business functions.
* Solutions-oriented, adaptable, and highly organized.

**Preferred** **Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of insurance industry experience, including carrier, regulatory, compliance, operational, or implementation-focused roles.
* 3+ years supporting compliance, regulatory enablement, product implementation, business change management, or cross-functional project delivery.
* 3+ years of forms management, forms implementation, policy administration changes, or regulatory change implementation experience.
* Knowledge of insurance operational workflows, carrier relationships, regulatory requirements, and implementation lifecycles.

#LI-Remote

National base pay range: $91,325 – $114,158 per year.

Chicago base pay range: $100,458 – $125,574 per year.

This is the range we reasonably expect to pay at hire. Placement within the range depends on job-related factors such as experience, skills, and certifications. This position is not eligible for bonus or incentive pay. Base pay is one part of a total rewards package that includes the benefits listed below.

All of our jobs come with great benefits including healthcare, parental leave and opportunities for career advancements. Some offerings are dependent upon the location of where you work and can include the following:

* Paid holidays and company-wide Wellness Day off

jobs.title: Works Implementation Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

**Organization:** Facilitron Inc

**About Us:** Facilitron is a funded, fast-growing (#30 in the Financial Times - America's Fastest Growing Companies in 2021) startup who partners with schools, colleges and municipalities across the United States to simplify the scheduling and maintenance of public spaces. With over 7-billion square feet of gyms, athletic fields, auditoriums, classrooms and more available to the public for rent, Facilitron is the leading marketplace for public space rentals. Today, thousands of schools and other public and private facility owners partner with Facilitron to rent and manage their real estate assets.

**Type of work:** Remote

**Salary**: $45K-$65K based on experience.

**Position**: Works Implementation Solutions Specialist

**Requirement: Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is strictly required.**

We are seeking a **Works Implementation Solutions Specialist** to assist our clients through onboarding, technical enablement, and ongoing daily operations. In this role, you will provide hands-on, high-touch support to ensure smooth rollouts and stable long-term platform use.

A background in **Maintenance & Operations (M&O)**—ideally with prior experience in a supervisory, team lead, or operational coordinator capacity—is required to understand our clients' physical/operational workflows and maintenance environments. **Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish** is strongly preferred to support our growing multi-regional account base.

**Key Responsibilities Implementation & Client Onboarding**

* Support end-to-end client implementations, helping configure systems, map workflows, and execute rollout plans under the guidance of project managers.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for operational queries and technical onboarding assistance during the client go-live phase.
* Deliver bilingual (English/Spanish) training sessions and step-by-step documentation to client end-users and maintenance teams.

**Operational & Account Support**

* Leverage M&O experience to understand client workflows, troubleshoot operational bottlenecks, and maintain system readiness.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve daily technical support tickets, escalations, and system configuration requests.
* Monitor account health, track recurring support patterns, and assist in maintaining high service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to escalate software bugs and advocate for client needs.

**Qualifications & Skills Required**

* **M&O Experience:** 2+ years of hands-on experience in Maintenance & Operations (M&O), preferably with past experience in a supervisory, lead technician, or coordinator role.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfort navigating ticketing systems, task tracking tools, and troubleshooting software configurations.
* **Problem-Solving & Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with a client-first, detail-oriented approach to resolving technical issues.

**Preferred**

* **Tech Support & Onboarding:** Experience working in software implementation, technical support, or account support at a B2B SaaS or technology company.
* **Language Skills:** Professional fluency (verbal and written) in both **English and Spanish**.
* **Education & Experience:** Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience in operations, technical support, or client management.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) 5% Match
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Language:

* English and Spanish (Required)

Location:

* Texas (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
About Uplinq

Uplinq is the AI-powered bookkeeping and tax automation platform built for small business owners. We’re re-engineering how entrepreneurs manage their finances, replacing manual bookkeeping, rules, and spreadsheets with intelligent automation that delivers real-time clarity and control.

We’re a Series A startup backed by top investors, growing fast. Our team is lean, execution-focused, and allergic to fluff. We measure success in demos booked, pipelines created, and revenue influenced.

Individual applicants residing in the US only

About the role

As a Senior Onboarding Accounting Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for new Uplinq clients — guiding them through system setup, data clean-up, and account activation.

This is a high-touch, high-volume role: you'll juggle a large, active portfolio of clients at different onboarding stages, which means the job rewards people who communicate early and often, adapt quickly when something isn't working, and hold themselves accountable for outcomes rather than just effort.

The right candidate will have a magnetic presence on calls and an excitement about interaction with small business owners. The ideal candidate is a person the clients look forward to speaking with, someone who makes them feel confident in the investment they’ve made when choosing Uplinq.

What you'll do

Lead daily client meetings to gather financial data, clarify scope, and build trust from the first call — earning it through rapport, clarity, and follow-through, not just technical accuracy.  
Set up and configure Uplinq and QuickBooks Online accounts, including resolving integration and access issues (Plaid connections, payroll, revenue processors, inventory systems, etc) so systems sync cleanly from day one.  
Compare signed proposals to actual client needs in the first call, and flag scope or pricing mismatches immediately — to sales, to your manager, and directly to the client — rather than letting a gap surface later and erode trust.  
Manage a high volume of onboarding timelines and deliverables simultaneously, and proactively speak up when your workload or a specific account is at risk of falling behind, so it can be addressed before it becomes a bigger problem.  
Troubleshoot setup and data issues using sound accounting judgment, and treat mistakes as fast information rather than something to hide — surface them quickly, learn from them, and adjust.  
Find workarounds to keep stalled onboardings moving — manual data entry when a feed breaks, alternate document paths, creative scheduling — because an on-time, good-enough solution beats a stalled account waiting for a perfect one.  
Collaborate with Sales, Initialization, Accounting, and Tax teams to resolve handoff gaps, own your part of the process end-to-end, and transition accounts smoothly into ongoing support.

Qualifications

6+ years in a client-facing accounting or onboarding role, ideally in public or multi-client accounting firm as Senior Associate level or higher  
6+ years of daily QuickBooks use including Online setup, integrations, and troubleshooting (not desktop).  
Strong working knowledge of both cash- and accrual-based accounting.  
Demonstrated ability to manage 25+ active client relationships at once without letting communication or follow-through slip — someone who escalates early, adapts on the fly, and takes ownership of outcomes rather than absorbing pressure silently.  
A warm, confident, and memorable presence with clients — someone who builds real rapport fast, puts anxious business owners at ease, and makes a technical process feel personal rather than transactional.  
Comfortable having direct conversations with clients about scope and pricing when what they signed doesn't match what they need, and willing to admit and correct course quickly when something's off.

Why Join Us

Competitive pay + health, dental, vision, 401(k), and life insurance  
Remote-first and flexible work culture  
Clear path for career growth in a fast-growing firm  
Modern tech stack and automation-first mindset  
Supportive, collaborative team with strong systems and documentation

Compensation Range: $75,000-$85,000

The pay range for this role is:  
75,000 - 85,000 USD per year(Remote)

Pay: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
GymFridge is building an AI Retail OS that helps gyms manage retail, automate ordering, and connect directly with suppliers. We’re live with Powerhouse and expanding to more gyms.

We’re looking for someone to take qualified introductions from our partners, run product demos, and guide new customers through onboarding.

You’ll work with warm leads, gym owners and operators who have already expressed interest in GymFridge. Your job is to book demo calls, show them the product, and guide them toward onboarding.

**Your role**

* Meet with gym owners and operators introduced by our partners.
* Understand their retail operations, needs, and current challenges.
* Deliver clear, engaging demos that show how GymFridge can help their business.
* Manage follow-ups and move interested gyms toward launch.
* Guide customers through setup and their first use of the platform.
* Turn customer feedback into clear requests for our product and development teams.
* Coordinate with the team to resolve questions and onboarding issues.

**What we’re looking for**

* Experience delivering software demos, onboarding customers, or selling B2B software.
* Strong presentation skills and confidence speaking with business owners.
* Ability to learn a product quickly and explain it in simple terms.
* Strong follow-through and clear written communication.
* Experience working with gyms or fitness software is a plus.

**Location**  
Remote anywhere in the U.S., with availability for customer calls during U.S. business hours.

**Opportunity**  
Work directly with the founder and product team at an early-stage AI startup. Help shape the customer experience and grow into a broader sales or customer success role.

Pay: $40,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

**Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid) or Remote (US)**

The Customer Onboarding Specialist is responsible for guiding new customers through a structured, high-quality onboarding experience that enables successful adoption, early value realization, and a smooth transition into ongoing support and success models. This role operates within the Professional Services & Onboarding organization and plays a critical role in setting the foundation for long-term customer outcomes.

**What You'll Do:**

#### **Customer Onboarding & Adoption**

* Execute standardized onboarding engagements aligned to defined onboarding frameworks and timelines
* Guide customers through setup, configuration, and orientation activities to ensure readiness and adoption
* Deliver training and enablement resources tailored to customer needs and maturity
* Identify onboarding risks, escalate issues appropriately, and support resolution to maintain momentum

#### **Delivery Execution & Coordination**

* Track onboarding progress against milestones, timelines, and success criteria
* Maintain accurate onboarding documentation, customer notes, and delivery artifacts
* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure smooth handoffs to Customer Success or Support teams

#### **AI-Enabled & Data-Driven Ways of Working**

jobs.title: Payroll Implementation Consultant - Remote
jobs.description:
Why Arcoro?

Want to work with a solid company that’s transforming HR for the construction industry? Our team of dedicated professionals helps construction, contracting and field services companies hire, manage and grow their workforce with a market-leading SaaS solution. As a member of the A-Team, you’ll enjoy a top-notch team member experience where you can embrace your problem-solving skills and innovation, work with a team of great teammates and see the impact of your contribution each day. Our culture is collaborative, and we believe strongly in training, growth and internal advancement. We offer competitive compensation including comprehensive benefits and a generous time-off policy. We offer both on-site and remote opportunities.

At Arcoro, you will help create software products that are cutting edge, easy to use, and that make an appreciated and notable difference in our customer’s daily lives.

About the Role

The Payroll Implementation Consultant takes Arcoro Payroll customers from signed agreement to an accurate first payroll run and a confident go-live. As Arcoro takes ownership of payroll setup from our partner Check, this is one of the first dedicated roles built to carry that work, so your customers will feel the difference a construction-focused team makes.

This is a growth role in a growing business line. Payroll is a meaningful part of Arcoro's plan, and the team is still early enough that you will help shape how we implement it. You will learn directly from our Payroll Implementation Team Lead, take on more complex customers as your skills build, and have a real hand in the tools, methodology, and training the team relies on as we scale.

What You'll Do

Implementation Delivery

* Own a portfolio of payroll implementations from kickoff through go-live and the first payroll runs
* Lead setup and data conversion for customers moving from a previous provider, with increasing ownership of complex cases as you ramp
* Guide customers through payroll setup, validation, and mirrored or parallel payroll to ensure accurate first runs
* Deliver consultative training so administrators can run payroll, reports, and year-end tasks on their own
* Follow Arcoro's implementation methodology, complexity tiers, and timelines, and flag early when a customer needs more time or support
* Learn and apply construction-specific payroll needs such as certified payroll, prevailing wage, and union fringe requirements
* Collaborate closely with Arcoro Time and HR implementation consultants on shared customers, aligning timelines and data so payroll, time tracking, and HR go live as one connected solution
* Coordinate with our partner Check during the transition period to resolve implementation issues and escalations
* Keep customers informed, monitor health during implementation, and raise risk early

Learning and Contribution

* Take part in coaching, shadowing, and training sessions, and apply what you learn on live implementations
* Track your hours by implementation and share what you learn, so estimates, capacity planning, and launch calendars stay accurate
* Capture lessons learned, gaps, and improvement ideas to strengthen the playbook and training
* Share product feedback from customers with Product and Support
* Partner with Sales and the wider Customer Experience team on smooth handoffs and accurate expectations

What Success Looks Like

* Payroll implementations delivered on schedule and accurate on the first payroll run
* A steady increase in the complexity and size of your portfolio as you ramp
* Progress toward FPC certification and a growing depth of payroll expertise
* High customer satisfaction, adoption, and retention through go-live
* Clear, timely status updates and hours tracking that help the team plan capacity
* Ideas and lessons from your implementations that make the playbook, training, or tools better

What We're Looking For

* Payroll experience in implementation, processing, or customer-facing payroll support, and strong payroll fundamentals
* Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC), or a commitment to earn it with Arcoro's support
* Curiosity, a coachable mindset, and a real interest in building a career in payroll implementation
* Strong communication and customer relationship skills, including guiding customers through data collection and validation
* Excellent organization and prioritization, with the ability to manage several implementations at once
* Dependable, proactive, and detail oriented, with comfort working through change in a growing business line
* Familiarity with SaaS or HCM platforms and payroll data migration (preferred)
* Familiarity with construction payroll needs such as certified payroll, prevailing wage, and union fringe (preferred)

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, Human Resources, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 1 to 3 years of payroll implementation, onboarding, or customer-facing payroll experience
* Experience with payroll migrations from a previous provider
* Experience collaborating with Sales, Product, and Support teams

Benefits

jobs.title: Implementation Manager, Core
jobs.description:
**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Implementation Manager, Core**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Director, Professional Services  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $100,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Core Implementation Manager (Core IM) is the sole owner of a portfolio of roughly 40+ First Due Core implementations, typically multi-module engagements. These standard and moderately complex projects carry real configuration complexity and frequently include CAD integration and historical data migration, requiring disciplined project management, strong customer command, and the ability to direct several internal specialists toward a single go-live date.

The Core IM owns the customer relationship and every project in the portfolio from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, and is accountable for planned duration, scope, risk, customer communication, and time to value. This is a fully autonomous role: you are self-directed on all delivery decisions inside the signed SOW and involve leadership only on commercial and relationship exceptions. Core delivery runs on a paired model: the Implementation Manager owns the project, the assigned Implementation Consultant owns module configuration and functional product depth, and Technical Services owns integration and data migration execution.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own a full portfolio of roughly 40+ concurrent Core implementations from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, consistently holding planned duration below team goal.
* Keep Rocketlane, the system of record, current always (plans, timelines, milestones, task status, owners, and dates) so any colleague can open a project and know exactly where it stands. Complete documentation and exit gates on time, not retroactively.
* Lead customer kickoffs with command: set clear expectations, correct unrealistic assumptions in the room, and close with an agreed action list, owners, and dates. Adapt the agenda to each agency’s politics and readiness based on Discovery.
* Run a progress cadence of at least bi-weekly check-ins on new acquisition projects and monthly on upsells, using each one to find and remove the real blocker rather than read status.
* Tailor each plan to the agency’s operational reality, including shift patterns, governance and approval cycles, budget calendars, and go-live blackout windows. Own multi-module sequencing, phasing, and dependency decisions across the platform.
* Direct and sequence the work of Implementation Consultants, Technical Services, Integrations, Support, and Product without direct authority, securing commitment on dates. Module configuration is owned by the assigned Implementation Consultant.
* Proactively surface product gaps, process gaps, communication silos, and methodology friction to leadership with supporting specifics and a proposed fix, and help own internal improvement efforts.

### **Qualifications:**

* This is a remote role, but the person hired must live in the US.
* 5+ years of experience managing customer-facing SaaS implementations (or 3+ years plus a master’s degree), including a portfolio of multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong public safety industry knowledge, including how fire, EMS, or law enforcement agencies operate and how decisions are made inside them.
* Demonstrated ownership of project plans, timelines, risk management, escalation recovery, and scope discipline, including change orders, on projects with multiple internal contributors.
* Proven ability to drive delivery outcomes through matrixed contributors without direct reporting authority.
* Working data literacy: comfortable reading record counts, spotting bad mappings, and assessing integration and migration risk.
* Experience with implementation project management tooling.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Excel.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including concise, actionable follow-ups, status reporting an executive stakeholder can act on, and delivering bad news early with a recommended path.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working to billable utilization targets in a professional services organization.
* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management credential.
* Experience with fire, EMS, or law enforcement records management, CAD systems, or emergency services software.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce.
* Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment with evolving methodology and tooling.

**For US-based Roles**  
All applicants must be authorized to work for any US employer in the United States. Locality Media LLC is unable to sponsor or transition sponsorship ownership of employment visas at this time. Hiring is contingent upon candidates successfully passing a criminal background check. As part of the I-9 verification of authorization to work in the US, Locality Media participates in E-Verify.  
  
**Physical Demands and Work Environment**  
This role is fully remote with minimal travel expectations at this time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified employees and applicants to perform the essential functions as outlined above. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please reach out to people@firstdue.com.  
  
**Working at First Due**  
First Due offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package for eligible employees, including competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA/HSA, 401(k), flexible PTO, a fully remote workplace, a technology stipend, opportunities for advancement, and other benefits and perks that sets our team apart. Visit www.firstdue.com to learn more.  
  
If you are a resident of a state requiring wage transparency, please reach out to people@firstdue.com for a reasonable estimate of annual base compensation and any eligible incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered to successful candidates for roles may be higher or lower, based on non-discriminatory criteria including but not limited to relevant professional experience, geographic location, knowledge, skills, and abilities. *This range will be reviewed on a regular basis.*  
  
First Due is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status or class. We are committed to promoting an environment of respect, acceptance, diversity and inclusivity, and equal opportunity. Discrimination and harassment of any type in any form will not be tolerated.  
  
When you apply for a role at Locality Media, LLC d/b/a First Due, we collect personal information such as identifiers (e.g., name, email, phone number), professional and employment information, education information, and information you provide in your application materials. We use this information to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you, and manage our recruiting process. We may share this information with our service providers who assist with recruiting and background screening. We do not sell or share applicant personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. We retain applicant information in accordance with our data retention policies. California residents have rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the CPRA. For more information, please review our Candidate Privacy.

jobs.title: EHR Analyst, Senior
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** EHR Analyst, Senior  
**Department:** Ambulatory Application  
**Location:** Riedman - Remote  
**Hours Per Week:** 40  
**Schedule:** Full-Time, Day-Shift, Monday to Friday, (8 am - 4:00 pm)

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day-to-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.

System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams - including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors - to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.

Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.

Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.

Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.
* Strong understanding of healthcare business process, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross-application integration knowledge.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  

* Minimum two (2) to five (5) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Health IT Analyst, Epic Analyst, or in a related healthcare information systems role.

LICENSURE/CERTIFICATIONS:

  

* Current Epic Certification.

Tasks often involve sitting at a workstation, using a computer, handling paperwork, and interacting with colleagues or visitors. Fine motor control is essential for typing and administrative tasks, while clear vision and hearing support accurate communication. jobs.title: Health Information Specialist I
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.  
  
By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

* This is an entry level position responsible for processing all release of information (ROI), specifically medical record requests, in a timely and efficient manner ensuring accuracy and providing customers with the highest quality product and customer service. Associate must at all times safeguard and protect the patient's right to privacy by ensuring that only authorized individuals have access to the patient's medical information and that all releases of information are in compliance with the request, authorization, company policy and HIPAA regulations.

  **Position Highlights:**

  + Full-Time: Monday - Friday, 8:00 am - 4:30 pm EST
  + Location: **Remote**
  + Comfortable working in a high-volume production environment.
  + Processing medical record requests by taking calls from patients, insurance companies and attorneys to provide medical record status
  + Documenting information in multiple platforms using two computer monitors.
  + Proficient in Microsoft office (including Word and Excel)  

  We offer:

  + Comprehensive onsite/virtual training program followed by job shadowing with an assigned mentor
  + Company equipment will be provided to you (including computer, monitor, virtual phone, etc.)
  Full Benefits: PTO, Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance and 401k Savings Plan and Tuition Assistance

  **You will:**

  + Receive and process requests for patient health information in accordance with Company and Facility policies and procedures.
  + Maintain confidentiality and security with all privileged information.
  + Maintain working knowledge of Company and facility software.
  + Adhere to the Company's and Customer facilities Code of Conduct and policies.
  + Inform manager of work, site difficulties, and/or fluctuating volumes.
  + Assist with additional work duties or responsibilities as evident or required.
  + Consistent application of medical privacy regulations to guard against unauthorized disclosure.
  + Responsible for managing patient health records.
  + Responsible for safeguarding patient records and ensuring compliance with HIPAA standards.
  + Prepares new patient charts, gathering documents and information from paper sources and/or electronic health record.
  + Ensures medical records are assembled in standard order and are accurate and complete.
  + Creates digital images of paperwork to be stored in the electronic medical record.
  + Responds to requests for patient records, both within the facility and by external sources, retrieving them and transmitting them appropriately.
  + Answering of inbound/outbound calls.
  + May assist with patient walk-ins.
  + May assist with administrative duties such as handling faxes, opening mail, and data entry.
  + Must meet productivity expectations as outlined at specific site.
  + May schedules pick-ups
  + Other duties as assigned.  

  **What you will bring to the table:**

  + High School Diploma or GED.
  + Ability to commute between locations as needed.
  + Able to work overtime during peak seasons when required.
  + Basic computer proficiency.
  + Comfortable utilizing phones, fax machine, printers, and other general office equipment on a regular basis.
  + Professional verbal and written communication skills in the English language.
  + Detail and quality oriented as it relates to accurate and compliant information for medical records.
  + Strong data entry skills.
  + Must be able to work with minimum supervision responding to changing priorities and role needs.
  + Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks.
  + Able to respond to requests in a fast-paced environment.  

  **Bonus points if:**

  + Experience in a healthcare environment.
  + Previous production/metric-based work experience.
  + In-person customer service experience.
  + Ability to build relationships with on-site clients and customers.
  + Comfortable bringing new ideas, process improvement suggestions, and feedback to internal stakeholders.  

  We are committed to building a diverse team of Datavanters who are all responsible for stewarding a high-performance culture in which all Datavanters belong and thrive. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

  Our compensation philosophy is to be externally competitive, internally fair, and not win or lose on compensation. Salary ranges for this position are developed with the support of benchmarks and industry best practices.

To ensure the safety of patients and staff, many of our clients require post-offer health screenings and proof and/or completion of various vaccinations such as the flu shot, Tdap, COVID-19, etc. Any requests to be exempted from these requirements will be reviewed by Datavant Human Resources and determined on a case-by-case basis. Depending on the state in which you will be working, exemptions may be available on the basis of disability, medical contraindications to the vaccine or any of its components, pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions, and/or religion.
  
  
This job is not eligible for employment sponsorship.  
  
Datavant is committed to a work environment free from job discrimination. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. To learn more about our commitment, please review our EEO Commitment Statement here. Know Your Rights, explore the resources available through the EEOC for more information regarding your legal rights and protections. In addition, Datavant does not and will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay.  
  
At the end of this application, you will find a set of voluntary demographic questions. If you choose to respond, your answers will be anonymous and will help us identify areas for improvement in our recruitment process. (We can only see aggregate responses, not individual ones. In fact, we aren't even able to see whether you've responded.) Responding is entirely optional and will not affect your application or hiring process in any way.  
  
Datavant is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need an accommodation while seeking employment, please request it here, by selecting the 'Interview Accommodation Request' category. You will need your requisition ID when submitting your request, you can find instructions for locating it here. Requests for reasonable accommodations will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

  

For more information about how we collect and use your data, please review our Privacy Policy.
